verdict.rationale: Checkout.com is a payments platform, not an AI agent or host application, so consuming third-party MCP servers as a client is outside its product category. Its documented MCP Server is the server role, where AI IDEs connect to Checkout.com; it does not let Checkout.com plug in other MCP servers' tools, so it cannot be credited here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
